The user wants to implement automatic detection and restart of the LSP server if it crashes or becomes unresponsive.
I have already performed 3 jobs (T1, T2, T3).
T1 looked for detection and scheduling of restart. Found `restart lsp for workspace`, `start`, `on transport reader eof`.
T2 looked for automatic restart mechanism. Found `on transport reader eof` only cleans state, restart functions are manual or config-based.
T3 looked for detection of unresponsiveness and scheduling. Found `schedule debounced lsp restart`, `stop`, `restart lsp for workspace`, `run`.

The "Cerrado" of T2 explicitly states: "no encontré un mecanismo de reinicio automático tras caída o no-respuesta; lo leído muestra que on transport reader eof solo limpia estado ready false sin relanzar, y las funciones de restart son invocadas manualmente o por cambios de configuración, no por el detector de fallos".
This suggests the feature requested by the user (automatic restart on crash/unresponsiveness) does not currently exist in the codebase in the way described, or at least not in the paths explored so far.
